en.text: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. is no one who does good.

zhSimplified.text: 愚顽人心里说：没有 神。

zhTraditional.text: 愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。

en.text: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

zhSimplified.text: 神从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有？

en.text: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

zhSimplified.text: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽；

zhTraditional.text: 他們各人都退後，一同變為污穢；

en.text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, God has rejected them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在无可惧怕之处就大大害怕，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在無可懼怕之處就大大害怕，

en.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

zhSimplified.text: 但愿的救恩从而出。 要快乐，要欢喜。

zhTraditional.text: 但願的救恩從而出。 要快樂，要歡喜。
